Done. The automation rules engine is implemented per the contract.

## Changed paths (all inside owns_paths)

**New — engine** (`lib/automation/`)
- `planner.ts` — `planSite`: keeps only `status='publish'` concerts with a non-empty link; resolves cities via `resolveCity` with the site's alias/region/tz overrides; unknown city → one `skip` with `unmapped_city`; groups by city, takes the nearest start after `now` (via `concertStartUtc` in the city timezone); `> stopHoursBefore` → `create` (name from `nameTemplate`, keywords via `renderKeywords`) + `start` when no project, or `start` when inactive; `≤` threshold or no future concert → `stop` when active; also stops active site-domain projects with no future concert; other-domain projects never appear (D1).
- `keywords.ts` — `renderKeywords` (`%город%`, `%в_городе%`, trim, dedupe keeping order), `toKeywordsCsv` (one keyword per line, no header).
- `executor.ts` — `executeActions`: dry-run → outcome `planned` for every action with zero client calls (D6); live `create` → `blocked`/`new_project_settings_missing` when `site.newProject` is null, otherwise `createProject(name, domain, region, provider, device)` → `uploadKeywords(CSV)` → `startPromotion`; live `stop` → `stopPromotion`, `StopFailedError` → `alert`; `ActionResult` carries `keywordsCount`, never the keywords array.
- `run.ts` — `runSite`: fetches concerts, flattens `catalogItems()` filtered to `site.domain`, reads `getAutolaunch(id).active` per project, plans, executes.

**New — tests** (`tests/automation/`): `planner.test.ts` (8 cases = acceptance a–h at now = 2027-01-29T12:00:00Z), `keywords.test.ts` (2), `executor.test.ts` (6, fake client counting mutating calls; no network).

## Verification (all exit 0, run in this session)
- `node --test tests/automation/planner.test.ts` → 8 pass
- `node --test tests/automation/keywords.test.ts` → 2 pass
- `node --test tests/automation/executor.test.ts` → 6 pass
- `! grep -rniq balance lib/automation` → 0
- Full suite re-run (`node --test` over all `tests/**`): 40 pass, 0 fail — neighboring tests untouched.

Two decisions worth knowing: live `create` also starts promotion, so the planner's paired `start` is recorded as `already_started_by_create` instead of issuing a redundant mutating call; the new project's id is read from the create response (`result.id`) — shape unconfirmed against the live cabinet, absence yields `alert` (open questions in `.bb/chats/thr_sfp5dqnpfn/notes/QUESTIONS.md`).

APPROACH: Built the four modules bottom-up (keywords → planner → executor → run) against the existing T1.4/T2.5 primitives (`resolveCity`, `concertStartUtc`, `startPromotion`/`stopPromotion` with built-in verification), then tests matching the acceptance cases one-to-one, with `node --test` fixtures chosen so concert times land exactly on the 47/48/49 h boundaries in real city timezones.

LESSON: A fake test double can silently make a failure path pass — the "stop fails" test first returned `done` because the fixture project was never active, so `stopPromotion` succeeded trivially; doubles must be seeded into the state the real flow requires.

NOT RUN: nothing — all four contract commands executed here; no live calls to lk.magicseo.ru (out of scope by contract).
